facts.text: I'm filing the story and Clark is buying lunch. He just doesn't know it yet.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Lois's real line when Superman catches her is 'You've got me? Who's got you?'.
facts.fix: You've got me? Who's got you?

fix_note.text: You've got me? Who's got you?

vibe.verdict: Good Daily Planet setting with the helicopter cue and Smallville, but it misses Superman's biggest moments.
